title.narrative: Promote well-being of conflict affected boys and girls as well as adolescents in Adamawa State through access to quality Child Protection and Education services.

description.narrative: ltpgt1. This proposal submission is for ltbgtthematic envelope 1lt/bgt (Underfunded sector area-based protection response) – Child protection and Education.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt2. This project will contribute to protection of girls and vulnerable women through:lt/pgtltulgtltligtProvision of psychosocial support and counseling services during positive parenting and awareness sessions.lt/ligtltligtProvision of life skill education and vocational training for adolescent girls including information of personal safety and hygiene, understanding women right and protection. lt/ligtltligtStrengthening community-based protection mechanisms that promote inclusion of women and girls in decision making process.lt/ligtltligtd. Women and girls will be empowered with knowledge and skills to protect themselves from abuse, sexual exploitation, violence and other forms of women right violations.lt/ligtltligtProvide multilingual support to reach a broader audience and accommodate various linguistic backgrounds.lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgt3. Our innovative approach is a context-based initiatives that seeks to strengthen capacities of the existing community-structures and government line ministries, women and girls and people living with disabilities. CPPLI will pilot an innovation to establish Community-Based Reunification Taskforce (C – BART) that comprises MWASD area officer, CBCPCs, NURTW, Police, Traditional leaders, foster parents, and vigilante groups through rigorous capacity building and mentorship programmes by CPPLI. The CBCPC members that will support prevention and response activities will be supported with tools of trade to enable them generate income to run their activities at the community level. The C-BART will receive financial support through the tools of trade that will be provided to the CBCPCs and support them to facilitate family reunification for unaccompanied children through collaboration with relevant community stakeholders mentioned above.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtCPPLI will also pilot the use of e-Referral Pathway App (eRPW). This App will contain different service providers cutting across health, GBV, child protection, HLP, WASH, nutrition, education, mine action etc. This App will allow partners to identify different actors implementing in Adamawa state particularly in all the LGAs where CPPLI is implementing this project. The App will also contain contact information of respective focal points for each organization for bilateral communication and inquiries before case is referred for assistance.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtLearning from previous implementation, CPPLI understand that some children become victims of abuse, exploitation and child labour especially in other distance clusters of the communities. In line with standard 8 ‘’physical and emotional maltreatment’’ and 12 ‘’child labour’’ of the child protection minimum standard, CPPLI will form women group of 20 women under ‘’Parenting start with me’’. These women will work collaboratively with the C-BART to conduct positive parenting and psychosocial support sessions for caregivers of children in different clustered communities. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThis project will support in achieving joint outcomes for children including women and girls including people living with disabilities. Thematically, the protection component of this project will strengthen the ecological framework that will directly support in addressing the risk factors and strengthening protective factors at individual, family, community, and the society level so that, children will have positive emotions, feel safe, protected and lead a life free from violence, abuse, neglect and exploitation and violence. While the education component of this project will enhance access to quality basic education services and vocational training for conflict affected boys and girls including children with disabilities to enhance their resilience ltspangtthrough promoting school as ltbgt“space of safety and protection” lt/bgtfrom any form of violence against children, and taking measures to address violence within schools.lt/spangtlt/pgt
